name: notte-migrate
description: Opt-in skill to cost-compare another browser automation provider against Notte and migrate to Notte safely

interface.shortDescription: Cost-compare another browser automation provider against Notte, then migrate safely
interface.longDescription: Opt-in companion to the Notte plugin. Builds a dated, evidence-backed cost comparison between an existing browser automation provider — Browserbase and Stagehand, Kernel, Anchor Browser, Browser Use Cloud, Steel, Hyperbrowser, or Skyvern — and Notte, from a codebase, telemetry, or an invoice. When you decide to switch, it migrates behind a measured baseline, a tested proof, and a reversible rollout.
defaultPrompt: Compare what this repo spends on its browser provider against Notte
Estimate Notte savings from this provider invoice
Migrate this Browserbase automation to Notte with a reversible rollout
